scripts.host:up: npm run core:fetch && docker compose --env-file host/.env -f host/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.host:migrate: docker exec tasker_frankenphp php public/index.php migrate run
scripts.host:seed: docker exec tasker_frankenphp php public/index.php seed
scripts.plugin:install: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File host/scripts/install-plugin.ps1 && npm run host:migrate
scripts.plugin:stan: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/repo" -w /repo/plugin php:8.4-cli php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse
